zh.name: 杂志风 · 工作流程
zh.summary: 先展示两条工作的完整步骤，再标出配合与交接，讲清事情如何一起完成。
zh.useWhen: 团队协作、周末市集和内容生产的并行分工。
zh.instructions: 给两条任务线、各自阶段、负责人、交付物和交接时机。
zh.output: 一组可编辑的小红书图文，默认 3 页。

en.name: Editorial Parallel Workflow
en.summary: Explain two side-by-side workflows and show who hands over what at each checkpoint.
en.useWhen: Working in pairs, production logistics, and content handoffs.
en.instructions: Provide both tracks, stages, owners, deliverables, and handoff times.
en.output: An editable Xiaohongshu carousel, typically three pages.
